name: Agentic Design System
description: Resolver for the agentic design system tokens: a mode-independent base set (semantic color aliases, spacing, typography, motion, elevation) plus a color-scheme modifier selecting the dark or light primitive color set.

base.description: Mode-independent tokens, including the semantic color alias tier that references primitives supplied by the color-scheme modifier.

color-scheme.description: Dark and light primitive color sets. Both contexts must define an identical token key set — the generator fails otherwise.
